title: Sr Linux Engineer
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation. At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individuals race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD. Responsibilities Oversee installation, configuration, and maintenance of Linux servers across diverse enterprise client environments. Serve as a senior escalation point for P1/P2 client incidents, ensuring timely SLA adherence, technical resolution, and clear communication to clients and internal stakeholders. Proactively maintain and develop all Linux infrastructure technology to deliver 24x7x365 uptime services. Perform system performance management, patching, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and reliability. Implement and enforce security best practices, vulnerability management, and compliance standards (CIS, NIST, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, or client-specific frameworks). Support incident, change, problem, and request management processes in alignment with ITIL frameworks. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Windows, Network, Security, Cloud) to deliver integrated client solutions. Lead or support client onboarding and migration projects by assessing Linux environments, standardizing configurations, and integrating systems into MSP monitoring and management platforms. Develop and refine SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge base articles to enable repeatable processes across multiple client environments. Implement and optimize monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK), generating reports for internal use and client presentations. Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and act as a role model for best practices. Participate in on-call rotation, including business hours, weeknights, weekends, and holidays. Qualifications Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or similar relevant field. 9+ years of hands-on experience in Linux administration (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian, or similar). In-depth knowledge of Linux systems: installation, configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and system hardening. Proven expertise with authentication, authorization, and identity integration: user/group management, SSSD/REALMD, Kerberos, and LDAP/AD. Strong scripting and automation skills in Shell, Perl, Python, and experience with configuration management (Ansible, Puppet, or Chef). Experience with virtualization (VMware, KVM) and exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Solid understanding of security and networking, DNS, NFS, SMTP, HTTP/S, SELINUX, and firewalls within Linux ecosystems. Familiarity with SAN/NAS storage management, LVM, and multipathing. Experience working in ITIL-driven environments with proven SLA accountability. Strong communication and client-facing skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Good to Have Certifications such as RHCE, Linux Foundation Certified Engineer, CompTIA Linux+, or relevant cloud/Linux certifications preferred. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD). Hands-on knowledge of containerization platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift). Experience using MSP/PSA/RMM tools (ServiceNow, ConnectWise, SolarWinds, Datto, etc.). Capacity planning and cost optimization experience in hybrid or multi-cloud environments. Why AHEAD: Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between. We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning. India Employment Benefits include: Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents Paid time off and company holidays , along with additional leave benefits as per policy Flexible work arrangements , supporting work-life balance Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations Inclusive and people-first culture , with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

 Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
